question.text: What is the opposite of a stock split called, where smaller face value shares are combined into shares of higher face value?

explanation.text: The Logic: Stock consolidation (also called reverse split) is the opposite of a stock split. Here, shares of a lower face value are combined into shares of a higher face value. For example, 100 shares of FV Rs.2 may be consolidated into 20 shares of FV Rs.10. The total value remains the same. The Trap: Candidates may confuse consolidation with buyback. In buyback, shares are extinguished and the company pays shareholders. In consolidation, no payment is made -- shares are merely combined.
